verses.translation: We sent it down on the Night of Glory.
What will explain to you what that Night of Glory is?

verses.text_uthmani: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
verses.translation: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months;

verses.text_uthmani: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
verses.translation: on that night the angels and the Spirit descend again and again with their Lord’s permission on every task;
[there is] peace that night until the break of dawn.
